# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-300#express-terminal-test-intent-through-page-objects

**Verdict: Caught.** Limited to the keyboard Escape-composition path and the phone composer soft-keyboard insert path observed below.

**Next proof action:** none for this promise on these paths; the maintained assertions already fail when insert submits.

## What was checked

- **Story and revision.** SEED-300#express-terminal-test-intent-through-page-objects (`.planning/seeds/SEED-300-dashboard-test-page-objects.md#express-terminal-test-intent-through-page-objects`), plan `.planning/slice-plans/583-terminal-test-intent/PLAN.md`, checked revision `a303c670a4cb4405571eb55d25ad97d8cd9cfb05` (final accepted execution tip including owned CI repair).
- **Promise.** Shared Terminal screen/input ownership keeps insertion without submit distinct from deliberate Enter: `insertTerminalText` never presses Enter; `typeLine` alone composes insert then Enter (story key example 3; plan architecture and slice-2/3 learnings). Expected observable: after soft-keyboard or helper insert, WebSocket/PTY evidence shows characters without a trailing Enter/CR until Enter is chosen deliberately.
- **Suggestion handling.** Kept the caller's preferred ownership promise and keyboard + touch focused set. Chose the “insert path merged with submit” fault rather than “typeLine no longer presses Enter”, because the keyboard and touch-composer specs already exercise `insertTerminalText` without submit and would not observe a typeLine-only regression. Fixture and assertions were left unchanged. Did not probe the `.terminal-screen` vs `.xterm-screen` or voice-import circular-import suggestions in this check.
- **Fault.** In isolated scratch only, `dashboard/tests/terminalScreenPage.ts` `insertTerminalText`: after `page.keyboard.type(text)`, added `await page.keyboard.press("Enter")`, merging insert with submit. One mechanics-owner edit; no fixture or assertion changes.
- **Fixture / maintained checks.** Same focused command for baseline, fault, and restore:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- tests/terminals/agent-terminal-keyboard.spec.ts tests/terminals/agent-terminal-touch-composer.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line
```

Host: macOS on AC (`caffeinate -s -i`), load high (~40–45), `--workers=1`. Scratch checkout `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-300-terminal-page-objects.6jqWsC` (detached `a303c670a…`), pre-probe and post-restore porcelain only `?? node_modules` (symlink into the execution worktree). Execution worktree was not edited for this probe.

- **Assertions that caught the fault.**
  1. `dashboard/tests/terminals/agent-terminal-keyboard.spec.ts:117` — `await expect.poll(() => attaches()[0]?.lines).toEqual(["x\u001by"])` in step “plain Escape in the terminal reaches the session and the panel stays”, after `insertTerminalText("x")`, Escape, `insertTerminalText("y")`, Enter. With the fault, received `["x", "", ""]` (early submits).
  2. `dashboard/tests/terminals/agent-terminal-touch-composer.spec.ts:113` — `await expect.poll(() => sent.join("")).toBe(\`${draftText} and typed\`)` in step “Insert reaches the PTY once without trailing Enter; direct typing stays available”, after `insertTerminalText(page, " and typed")`. With the fault, received the same text plus a trailing CR (`\r`), proving insert submitted.

## Run observations

- **Baseline:** 2/2 passed in **25.7 s** (runner-reported). Both cases executed.
- **Fault:** 2/2 failed. Wrong behavior observed on both exercised paths (premature PTY lines / CR in sent frames) before the named assertions failed. Line reporter printed no aggregate duration.
- **Restore:** `git checkout -- dashboard/tests/terminalScreenPage.ts`; SHA256 matched `HEAD` blob `db8b52bba34039a859bced6e269933cf42624848ba1bf49a44d073f2be309eb1`; `git diff --exit-code` clean for that file; porcelain matched pre-probe (`?? node_modules` only). Restored rerun: 2/2 passed in **18.3 s**. Scratch worktree then removed with `git worktree remove --force`.

No already-planned repair or prior disposition matched this specific probe beyond the story’s already-delivered insert≠Enter ownership; this check does not open a new repair.

## Costs

- **Test runtime.** Measured runner-reported baseline **25.7 s** and restored pass **18.3 s** (**44.0 s** combined). Fault-run aggregate runner time unavailable (line reporter printed failures without a total duration); fault command wall clock was about **32.6 s** including Playwright startup (shell-measured, not runner-reported).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable; no separate human-time measurement was supplied.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable; the host exposed no independent agent-effort measure.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 262228 ms (measured), from 1794478964516 to 1794479226744 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

- Checked revision: `a303c670a4cb4405571eb55d25ad97d8cd9cfb05`.
- Evidence: `/tmp/seed300-intent-coverage-report.md` (Caught; insert≠Enter on keyboard Escape-composition and phone composer insert paths).
- Decision: no follow-up. Maintained assertions already fail when insert submits; no backlog or correction from this check.
- Canonical follow-up links: none.
